answer: In a Wesolowski VDF, identity verification binds each claimed agent to a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings: every square depends on the previous result, so distributing clones across GPUs cannot shorten any individual proof’s delay. An attacker may mirror identities, but must pay the same wall-clock cost per clone, making Sybil expansion resource- and time-limited; delta marks no shortcut, while sonnet is merely an irrelevant label.
